def snap(f):
    d={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        c=n['color']
        if c in ('N','W','G','c','b','g'):
            xs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]; ys=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
            d.setdefault(c,[]).append((min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs),n['pixels']))
    return d
